content.title: Local reads denied, fetches bounded, no code execution
content.lede: The document is the attack surface: it can name network resources and, only when the operator opts in, local files. Nothing in the pipeline executes document code.

content.heading: Defaults
items: Local file access is blocked by default. Use the CLI --allow-local-files flag or Document.AllowLocalFiles for authored local templates.

NetworkPolicy defaults to CompatibleNetworkPolicy (localhost and private addresses allowed); RestrictedNetworkPolicy or --restrict-network blocks private destinations and cross-host redirects unless an --allow-host entry permits them (internal/load/load.go:135-153).
Primary documents, CSS, images, fonts, and header/footer resources share loader ACLs, timeouts, redirect limits, and body caps.

JavaScript is never executed: there is no JS engine and no os/exec in the tree, and JS-related flags (--enable-javascript, --javascript-delay, --run-script, --window-status, --debug-javascript) are rejected as unknown options by the CLI (internal/cli/cli.go:238).
Treat remote or untrusted HTML as an egress request. Use an isolated worker without credentials for content you did not author.

content.heading: Security controls
rows: Denied by default; --allow-local-files / Document.AllowLocalFiles enables broad reads; --allow / Document.Allow adds prefix-scoped ACL exceptions (symlinks resolved before the check)

CompatibleNetworkPolicy by default (localhost and RFC1918 allowed); RestrictedNetworkPolicy or --restrict-network blocks private destinations and cross-host redirects; 30 s connect / 60 s response, 10 redirects, 100 MiB body cap
Never executed; no JS engine and no os/exec; JS-related flags are rejected as unknown options
Validate runs before the writer is opened; callers own the selected sink
Operator-provided configuration only; never embed secrets in untrusted jobs

content.heading: Explicit local-file policy

content.title: Isolation still matters
content.body: No renderer can turn arbitrary remote HTML into a safe input automatically. Compatible network policy reaches localhost and RFC1918 addresses; use RestrictedNetworkPolicy or --restrict-network for content you did not author. Validate or generate HTML server-side, remove cookies and custom headers from untrusted jobs, leave local files disabled unless required, and isolate workers when the source is not trusted.
